name: elastic-supported block ballastless track
definition_zh: 以弹性部件支承承轨块、通过分层结构实现隔振的无砟轨道。

complete_examples.text: To investigate the deformation law of elastic-supported block ballastless track systems under adverse geological conditions involving foundation deformation, a detailed numerical simulation model of elastic-supported block ballastless track in tunnel was establish through ABAQUS software.

The model considered the special structure of the elastic-supported block ballastless track where the slab was constructed directly on the invert, while the influence of the amplitude and wavelength of the foundation deformation on the displacement of the rail and the slab, and the height and the length of the gap between the slab and the foundation were analyzed.
